problem: The composer stacked a dense black overlay on a dark HUD material, so it looked unrelated to the shared glass background. Product branding was also repeated in the title, message senders, loading state, status bar, full-screen chrome, and composer placeholder.
solution: Centralized the display name as Trinity S3AI using an ASCII-safe Unicode escape, retained it only in the application title, hid assistant and system sender labels, removed repeated local typing and status labels, and made the composer use the content glass opacity with the under-window material.
lesson: Branding should identify the workspace once, not compete with the conversation. A nested glass composer should reuse the content opacity and a compatible material instead of stacking an independent dark appearance.
